notes.title: 📢 Build 0.2.7 Update – Smaller Maps & Better Agawan Base Rules!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Kendrick here, Game Designer of Langit Lupa. 



I’m super excited to share that Langit Lupa Build 0.2.7 is now live!



I’ve made the maps smaller this time because I noticed during streams and playtests that there was a lot more hiding than chasing. I want every match to feel fast, exciting, and full of action—so now, there’s less running away and more fun catching each other. And just imagine how wild it gets with 8 players!



I’ve also tweaked the Agawan Base rules to make the game easier to understand and more fun to play. Now it works like this:



You get +1 point for capturing an enemy.

+5 points for capturing all enemies.

+5 points when you rescue a teammate.

And of course, you can still touch your base to power up or become the tagger.





With these changes, the game feels a lot more like the classic chase I loved growing up—where you get to turn the tables and catch the person who was chasing you just a moment ago.



I hope you give it a try and have as much fun as we did making it. Thanks so much for playing and being part of this journey with me!

The rest are boring server-stuff…
Don’t have to read this part. But I’ll write anyway so I won’t forget.


 Changed server to Relay. This means, it’s not a dedicated server anymore, but peer to peer. 
 Maintaining dedicated game servers are pretty intense and time-consuming, and I thought it’s an overkill for this type of game. Maybe we’ll get back to it in the future, for now, we’re going peer-to-peer for faster iteration.
 Added fail safes when users get stuff at loading or countdown
 Host can change the game time
